INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Public speaking – Impromptu speech.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

4. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

6. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Essay writing – Expository essay.

7. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

8. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive reading – Library skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Social writing – Cards.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Self-expression – interviews and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading for comprehension – Play and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 6.3.1 Writing to give information – Dialogue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Essay writing – Descriptive composition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
